rows.reviewerNote: Judged as a new question. Key true in both windows (line 51 'I could see him plainly'; line 71 'distinct and pale'). The sunset is line 8, outside both windows. 'Describes each person in full first' fails at lines 70 to 72, which have no person, and fails at lines 26 to 56 (actions first). 'Never describes a person' fails at lines 52 to 56. There is no stem echo. The key is 11 words, against 12 to 13 for the distractors, so it is not a stand-out. Its opening 'She tells us' is shared with the sunset distractor. The unchanged hint ('Find the words that match up') names a move. The walk states the key. On techniqueKey 'the-light-is-reported-before-the-description': it is staff-facing and never served to a child, so it does not block this row. But it now names the order claim this round removed, so it is false about the item. It is read by composeMockPaper's technique-collision exclusion (techniqueKeyOf, packages/core/src/blueprints.ts) and listed by audit:technique-keys. JE-12 is its only carrier in the DB, so no paper is affected today. answerShape 'observation-bounded-by-conditions' fitted the old bounded key and no longer fits either. Both are Cowork-authored, so this repo should not rename them in place. Send them back with the export for Cowork to rename.
